note: NPC lines and the opening chain's script. {rider} is the rider's name, {short} is how much money is missing. Speaker narrator has no name box.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your first bike: a tired 50cc, bought with everything you had. You kick it over. Nothing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The garage on the high street fixes anything with an engine. Maybe the mechanic there can help.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Press Tab or tap Bike to check your bike, your bag and your current task.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: So you're the new rider everyone's on about? Let's have a listen to that 50.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The mechanic pulls the plug, squints at it, and shakes their head.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Top end's gone. Zero compression. That bike's going nowhere until it's replaced.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Here, take this used top end. It's off a customer's old bike and it's still got plenty of life in it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I haven't got any tools.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: No, you'd need a proper workshop for that. Use my bench. It's £90 for bench time and the gaskets. Fit it and I'll pay you £120 for helping out after.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You got a used top end. The workbench is in the far corner of the garage.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bench time is £90. You're {short} short.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You strip off the old cylinder head, clean the gasket faces and fit the new top end, step by step.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One kick. Two. The little 50 coughs, then settles into a crackly idle. It runs!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hear that? Sounds like a bike again. Nice work. Here's the £120 I promised.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If you're after more, I've got jobs. First, pop to the general bike shop up the road and collect my parts order.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The garage order? It's right here. Mind, it's heavier than it looks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Once you're racing, come back and see me for parts. I stock Grades 1 to 3 for the 50s and 65s.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Lovely, that's everything. Here's £50 for the legwork.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Now, there are two customer bikes on the stands. Give them both a service: chain, filter and a once-over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You adjust the chain, wash the air filter and check every bolt. That's one bike done.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Neat work. You've got the hands for this. That's £100.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Next, the tyres and wheels shop has a pair of tyres for me. Fetch them and fit them on my tyre machine.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: For the garage? Here you go, one pair of hard-pack tyres.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Hard pack round here, so you'll want a hard-pack rear on your own bike too, one day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You break the beads, lever the old tyres off and seat the new ones. It's harder than it looks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Not a pinch in sight. Here's £70.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: One more errand. This cylinder needs a rebore, and the engine rebuilder in the Industrial Zone does the best work. It's east along the main road.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: From the garage, is it? Give it here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lathe whines for a minute. The engine rebuilder hands the cylinder back, bright and true.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There you go. If you ever want shifts, I've always got engine work. So does the fabrication shop next door.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Perfect bore. That's £80.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You'll want to get to the tracks next, and for that you need a van. Go and see the van seller, south of here.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: The mechanic sent you? Then you'll want the old van out back.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: It's high mileage, but it starts every time. It holds one bike, twenty parts and ten tools. Six hundred quid, no haggling.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I'll come back when I've got the money.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six hundred for the van? Fair price. Here's £40 extra for all your help today.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: If you're still short, the fabrication shop and the engine rebuilder always need shift workers.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, and the council's finally finished the roadworks on the west road. That's your way to the tracks.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Six hundred, and you're {short} short. Shifts in the Industrial Zone pay. Come back when you've got it.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Pleasure doing business. Here are the keys. I've parked it outside your room.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Load your bike and your spares before you set off. A rider without spares is a spectator.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You wheel the bike up the ramp, strap it down, then load your spares and tools.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Everything has its place. Ready to go racing.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Got yourself a van? Then you're a proper racer now.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Try Farmland MX first. It's hard pack, flowing, and good for a first race. Take the west road out of town.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: There are two more tracks round here, but they're private. You'll need to do the owners a favour before they'll let you ride.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: See you on the gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Not now, I'm in the middle of something. Check your task.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: How's the 50 running? Bring it round if you need bench time.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Treat that van right and it'll get you to every track in the area.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Parts for 50s and 65s, Grades 1 to 3. Have a look at the counter.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Tyres, rims, spokes. Hard pack round here, so you'll want a hard-pack rear.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Looking for shifts? Use the blue bench inside to start a batch of frame brackets. It's 75p a bracket.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Want a shift? Start at the long bench inside. It's £1.25 a piston.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Do enough work for me and I might let you use the practice yard.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: You race? There are three local tracks round here, but you'll need a van to reach them.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Farmland MX, west road. I'll see you on the gate.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Race office. Sign on here for race days and practice.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: New face. Signing on for the 50s? Don't worry, everyone gets lapped by me once.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Not bad out there. Keep coming back. I'll be on the gate every week.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: This old machine? Put a clean part in and see what comes out. Not today, though.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.text: Oh, hello! I'm always on this computer. Pop round any time.
